explication: This is a FastAPI proxy that accepts Anthropic Messages API requests and routes them to OpenAI, Gemini, or Anthropic through LiteLLM, translating request and response formats. Its principal workflow supports both streaming and non-streaming messages, including tool use; a separate endpoint handles token-count requests. The README documents provider selection, model mapping, and Vertex AI authentication. The excerpts show only parts of server.py, so internal helper wiring beyond the documented workflow is not detailed.
